package player

import (
	idle "example.com/idle-sim-practice/game/idlesim"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest/entitytimer"
	"time"
)

const TimerProduction int32 = 1

func (c *TimerComponent) registerTimerHandlers(h *entitytimer.Handlers) {
	h.Register(TimerProduction, func(f entitytimer.Fire) time.Duration {
		d := c.owner.Dao()
		if d.GetWakeTimer() != f.ID {
			return 0
		}
		s, err := idle.Decode(d.GetState())
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		if f.Param1 != f.Deadline.UnixMilli() || s.NextDeadline() != f.Param1 {
			panic(idle.ErrRule)
		}
		if err := s.Advance(f.Now.UnixMilli()); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		d.SetState(s.Encode())
		d.SetWakeTimer(0)
		// 单次有界补算后从 now 重排；不延长 Horizon，不补发逐秒 tick。
		if deadline := s.NextDeadline(); deadline != 0 {
			id := c.NewTimerAt(time.UnixMilli(deadline), TimerProduction, deadline, 0, nil)
			if id == 0 {
				panic(idle.ErrRule)
			}
			d.SetWakeTimer(id)
		}
		return 0
	})
}
